title: Use Ignition log in the web UI to investigate Ignition-related issues before/around OptiSweep restart
summary: When Ignition-related issues occur (for example, Ignition taking too long and OPC retry behaving oddly), use the Ignition log available in the Ignition web UI to review log evidence for the relevant time window. If logs/memory details are implicated, route the memory details question to controls as suggested by the source.
when_to_use: Use when Ignition issues are suspected as the cause of OptiSweep restart needs—specifically when Ignition “took too long” and the “retry”/OPC behavior is described as weird/odd, and you need evidence from the Ignition web UI log.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Access the Ignition web UI and review the Ignition log entries for the relevant time window to support Ignition-related troubleshooting.
Controls (escalation target): Provide/confirm interpretation of “logs and memory details” when the source indicates memory details are implicated.
access_or_tools_needed: Ability to view Ignition logs in the web UI (as referenced by the source)

visual_references.description: Ignition Gateway UI web browser view; source describes memory usage chart and that this is the Ignition performance page accessible via web browser.

steps.title: Open the Ignition web UI and locate the Ignition log referenced by the source
steps.purpose: Get to the Ignition web UI location where the source indicates the Ignition log is available for troubleshooting evidence.
steps.instruction: Open the Ignition Gateway web UI in a web browser and navigate to the Ignition log area referenced by the source (the source explicitly states the Ignition log is “right in that web UI”).
steps.expected_result: You can view the Ignition log within the Ignition web UI.
steps.healthy_condition: The Ignition web UI loads and the Ignition log view is accessible for reading.
steps.failure_condition: The Ignition log is not accessible in the web UI (cannot load or cannot find the log view).

actions.label: Open Ignition Gateway web UI
actions.exact_action: Ignition can be accessed through the web browser.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Ignition log is not accessible or does not provide useful information, escalate to controls/support as suggested by the source.

steps.title: Review Ignition log entries for the time window when Ignition took too long / OPC retry behaved oddly

steps.purpose: Follow the source guidance that memory details interpretation is a controls responsibility when memory is implicated.
steps.instruction: If the investigation indicates memory details may be implicated, treat “logs and memory details” as items to ask controls about (per the source).
